text:
amy: FYI deploybot failed to push the canary image to gcr.eu-west-4. It blocked the publish due to inconsistent provenance annotations between mirror replicas. Holding the window.
josh: can you paste the error?
amy: from deploybot: 

```
> deploybot: publish rejected for repo=redwood/runtime:staging-20260321-rc3 -> gcr.eu-west-4
> reason: provenance metadata inconsistency: 'ci_build_id' values diverge across mirrors (ci-778 vs ci-777)
> enforcement: deny-to-prevent-ambiguous-tag
```

maria: that smells like the image-labeler ran twice on parallel runners and raced. Are digests identical?
amy: yes digests match across mirrors. Only the ci_build_id label is different. The oidc stamp step sometimes duplicates when retry happens.
kevin: if digest matches we can avoid a new publish by promoting the digest directly. That keeps provenance noisy but avoids rebuilding. Any policy concerns?
josh: policy-wise we prefer not to accept mismatched provenance, but promoting a verified digest is allowed if we log an exception and file a follow-up.
maria: ok. Plan suggestion: 1) pause automated tag push; 2) manual promote the verified digest via deploybot to the eu-west-4 canary (no republish); 3) add a changelog entry noting manual pin and reason; 4) create a fix ticket for image-labeler retry dedupe.
amy: +1. I'll initiate promote but deploybot wants explicit approvers due to change-window semantics.
deploybot: manual promote request received: `deploybot promote --digest sha256:deadbeef001122 --target gcr.eu-west-4/canary`
deploybot: approval_required: 2 approvers from channel or release-manager.
oncall-bot: change-window open until 11:00 UTC. If you proceed, please ack so oncall can temporarily relax publish gating for that digest.
josh: ack from me.
maria: ack and I'll add release-note line: "Canary pinned to sha256:deadbeef001122 because automated publish was rejected due to divergent provenance labels; no rebuild performed."
kevin: rollback criteria: if error budget breach >1% sustained for 5m or latency spike >2x baseline for 5m, we revert to previous sha256:beefcafe0099 and notify customers. I'll standby to run the revert script.
amy: starting manual promote now and will request approvals.
deploybot: approval recorded from josh and maria. Promoting sha256:deadbeef001122 -> gcr.eu-west-4/canary.
deploybot: promote complete. Note: provenance annotations will reflect original builds; we recorded an exception ticket (#INF-4237).
amy: promote succeeded. I've updated the release notes and opened INF-4237 to debug the labeler dedupe. We'll monitor metrics for 20m.
josh: monitoring dashboards show no error bump at 5m.
maria: added note in release changelog and flagged for the weekly postmortem slot.
kevin: still on standby for rollback, but looks stable at 10m. Good work.
amy: closing the hold. We'll follow up with a short incident blurb and the labeler fix. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
